title: Show the system uptime
description: Show how long the system has been running.
notes: On Windows, subtract it from Get-Date to get the duration. On Linux, 'uptime' without options gives more information.

windowsExamples.description: Show the date and time of the last boot (Windows)

linuxExamples.description: Show the uptime in a readable format (Linux)
